digest.component_or_area: Cloud rate-limit sweep, Jira adapter modules
propositions: The Cloud rate-limit sweep's file list is hardcoded rather than derived, so a classified mutating method renamed or moved to an unswept sibling module escapes the sweep without detection.
A classified mutating name is permitted outside the swept transport modules only when its body is a pure same-name delegation to self.transport with arguments forwarded unchanged.
The anti-drift guard must scan all non-swept Python modules in adapters/jira/ and reject any classified mutating name that is not a pure transport facade.
Currently exactly two definitions in backend.py (set_relationship and add_comment) collide with _CLASSIFIED_MUTATING names and are known-benign pure delegations.
The explicit transport file list must remain scoped to the four declared modules and not expand via package-wide glob, preserving the sweep's transport-layer subject rather than redefining it.
An unswept module defining or moving a classified mutating name without the pure-facade shape must cause the anti-drift test to fail and report the collision.
